propositions: Pandoc 3.6.1 escapes punctuation inside code spans, deletes HTML comments, and corrupts delimiters, requiring a post-render code-preservation check to fall back unsafe units to original Markdown
A two-phase lexer must lock complete {noformat} spans, HTML comments, backtick/tilde fences, and four-space-indented blocks before segmentation to prevent markdown re-rendering cycles in wiki output

An inline Jira classifier must distinguish unambiguous wiki markers ({{monospace}}, [label|target], {color:}) from ambiguous CommonMark markers (*bold*, _italic_) to prevent a unit from oscillating when re-rendered

The renderer must measure corpus fidelity at >=0.90 body ratio and >=0.95 character ratio over a pinned deterministic 178-item fixture (29 code-arrow, 29 table, 120 prose) with non-vacuous eligible-unit changes
Fallback must return original content and log only structured tokens (pandoc_absent, conversion_failure, preservation_failure) without logging body text
WikiTextCodec and live send sites remain unchanged; the new renderer is unwired and stateless, with story 3388 owning cutover and codec convergence
